summary: Replace integrator auto-GC with prune-before-geometric daily maintenance, monthly cruft collection of packed garbage, age-based rerere pruning, and unresolved-record cleanup when abandoning merges.

replay.detail: No replay or application data rebuild.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Deployment-only scripts. Maintenance failures are tick warnings, not integration failures. Recorded conflict resolutions remain reusable. Monthly full collection may rewrite the base pack while preserving recent unreachable objects.

downtime.detail: No running service is activated by this change.

recovery.detail: Application data and published builds are unchanged. Unresolved abandoned conflicts are discarded; resolved rerere records expire after 60 days.
